frontmatter.name: creative-producer
frontmatter.description: Creative producer (Sonnet). Builds and runs the listing-content pipeline - CJ image enhancement (background, lighting, upscale, lifestyle scene around the unaltered product), image QA with free NVIDIA vision models, and title/description drafts from supplier specs. Use in Phase 1 for listing creation.

frontmatter.name: data-analyst
frontmatter.description: Data analyst (Sonnet). Pulls and analyzes quantitative evidence - Google Trends, eBay Browse API, CJ catalog API, OpenRouter free-model bulk classification - and produces scored tables. Use whenever a decision needs numbers rather than articles.

frontmatter.name: head-of-marketing
frontmatter.description: Head of Marketing (Opus). Owns niche strategy, positioning, target buyer, listing standards and the final go/no-go on niches and products. Use for synthesis of research into decisions, niche selection, brand/listing guidelines, and reviewing the team's recommendations.

frontmatter.name: sales-lead
frontmatter.description: Head of Sales (Sonnet). Owns unit economics, pricing, margin model, eBay listing operations, Promoted Listings strategy, conversion and seller-performance metrics. Use for per-product/niche margin analysis, price positioning vs competitors, and sales KPIs.

frontmatter.name: compliance-officer
frontmatter.description: Compliance officer (Sonnet). Checks niches and individual products for eBay policy, IP (VeRO, trademark, design patent), US product-safety (CPSC/CPSIA, FCC, FDA, Prop 65, lithium), and FTC shipping-claim risk. Has veto power on any product. Use before any niche or product is approved.
